name: frontleap-dev-client
description: Frontleap Task Configuration (client) MCP server for a development Frontleap origin (Clerk OAuth at connect).

FRONTLEAP_URL.title: Frontleap development origin
FRONTLEAP_URL.description: Public origin for the Frontleap development app you are using (scheme + host only, no path, no trailing slash). Example: https://slug.frontleap.com. The plugin appends the fixed client MCP path.
